key_insight: A semi-supervised machine learning model using rectal biopsy RNA-seq can predict relapse risk after anti-TNF withdrawal in ulcerative colitis.
clinical_relevance: This could help identify patients at high risk of relapse before stopping anti-TNF therapy, potentially supporting safer treatment decisions.
method: Trained on baseline rectal biopsy transcriptomics from UC patients in the BIOSTOP trial.
Used a shared UMAP manifold plus LabelSpreading on a 38-gene panel.
Validated on separate test and follow-up cohorts, with SHAP used to interpret key genes.
evidence_signal: The model achieved AUC 0.794 with 90.3% sensitivity and 73.1% specificity in the test cohort, and AUC 0.711 with 82.9% sensitivity and 42.3% specificity in the inference cohort.
watch_item: Specificity was only moderate to low in validation, so larger multicenter studies are needed before clinical use.
paper_title: Machine learning predicts relapse after anti-TNF withdrawal in ulcerative colitis using rectal biopsy transcriptomics
